She maintains a neutral mouth position but keeps her eyes fixed on the viewer with a slight squint, conveying a mock-angry or serious attitude. The floral pattern of her shirt and the background posters are still visible in the medium close-up. (6) She begins to speak while maintaining eye contact with the camera. Her facial expressions are animated, with her eyebrows moving as she enunciates words. She gestures slightly with her head and shoulders, showing engagement in a conversation. The lighting highlights the texture of her skin and the details of her green earrings. (7) The woman turns her head away again, once more highlighting the gold bow-shaped hair clip in her hair. She continues to speak with high facial animation and expressive movements of her eyes and mouth. The video concludes with this side view, emphasizing the accessory while she completes her spoken reaction.
